pairs.registryProposal: progress-beat-grammar and the in-flight half of recall-transparency assume a token tail the runtime can sieve and preview. A turn that is one blocking completion has no tail; the standard does not say whether that shape must grow a stream or whether a fixed waiting sentence is enough.
